title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Training Note: Household Share of the Phone Payment Fee
content:
*Training note, financing care desk.*

**The rule.** The phone payment fee charged on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account is multiplied by the household share: a closed entry or patio door contract paid by cash, check or card takes the door-customer phone share of 85%; otherwise an active CareLine service plan takes the CareLine phone share of 95%; otherwise it is left whole.

**Q. What counts as a CareLine service plan?**
A. A CareLine service plan here means a CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate plan in active status; an On-Call Service Account is not a CareLine plan. It is read from the customer's CareLine Service Plans records.

**Q. What counts as the door contract?**
A. A contract in the customer's Entry & Patio Door Contracts records whose payment method is cash, check or card and whose status is closed. A door contract paid through Ridgeline financing, or one not yet closed, does not count.

**Q. What if the customer has both?**

| Closed cash-paid door contract | Active CareLine plan | Fee multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 85% |
| Yes | No | 85% |
| No | Yes | 95% |
| No | No | 100% (whole) |

**Q. When is the fee rounded?**
A. The share multiplies the fee before rounding; only the final fee is rounded to the cent, to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounding up.

**Q. Hypothetical example.** A fee of 12.95 for a customer with an active CareLine Basic Plan and no door contract: 12.3025, which rounds to 12.30 as a final fee.
